title: How a Man of God Starts the Job He's Been Avoiding
caption:
The task you're dodging is a test of faith.

Everyone has the job that keeps sliding to tomorrow. A man of God doesn't wait to feel ready. He names it, shrinks it to ten minutes, does it for the Lord (Colossians 3:23), and closes the loop before bed.

Start the thing today. Then tell a brother.

Save this for Monday morning.
